reason: The label is the cleanest I've seen on a caffeinated can: water, yerba mate, fruit concentrate, nothing else. So I'd grab one at a bistro out of curiosity, but I don't drink energy drinks and I'm not switching from my usual tea.
objection: 55 CZK for one can is a lot on my budget for something I'd drink now and then, and I don't really need 80 mg of caffeine. I'd brew loose mate at home for a fraction of that.
would_change_my_mind: A bio/organic certification on the yerba mate and a smaller multipack price around 40 CZK a can would make me buy it regularly instead of once.
